title: Treat configuration persistence failure as a failed save
description:
Review: Astra adversarial review — code simplicity and layout.

## Source locations

- `server/server.go:74`
- `server/server.go:209`
- `server/server.go:212`
- `server/server.go:213`

## Evidence

reconfigure applies the engine configuration then discards both json.MarshalIndent failure and os.WriteFile's result, publishes Config, and returns nil. Startup also ignores all configuration read errors, not just absence. Save uses direct overwrite rather than atomic replacement.

## Reproduction / validation

Start with a config path whose parent is missing or unwritable, or make the config file unwritable, then save configuration. API returns OK and state reports the new config despite no durable update. A non-ENOENT read error similarly silently loads defaults.

## Impact

Settings presented as successfully saved disappear on restart; unreadable configurations silently reset behavior and partial writes can corrupt the only copy.

## Acceptance criteria

Surface actionable read/write errors, distinguish missing config from unreadable config, and persist through an atomic replacement with an explicit application/persistence failure contract. Tests exercise invalid/unwritable config paths and ensure failed saves are not reported as successful durable saves.

## Confidence

high; direct ignored-error proof

## Completion evidence

Configuration saves serialize stage/write/fsync, engine application and atomic rename. Failed staging leaves the engine untouched; a failed rename restores the previous engine config and publishes that restored state. Read/parse failures are actionable startup errors; absence alone permits defaults. Replacement preserves existing file permissions and cleans staged files.

Full server race suite, embedded binary build and check-types pass. Regression coverage exercises missing parents, a directory target (rollback after engine application), unchanged original JSON, successful durable saves, retained 0600 mode and no leaked staging files.

Live browser against isolated built app on port 3002: moved its config parent aside, toggled AutoStart and clicked Save; inline stage-configuration error appeared while synced AutoStart stayed false. Restored parent and retried Save: no error and AutoStart true in memory and disk. Restarted the binary and reopened settings: AutoStart remained true with the configured download path. CLI with a directory config path exited 1 with an explicit read error. Isolated app stopped and scratch removed.
